description.en: Islands of billions of stars scattered across the cosmos — including our own Milky Way and the vast web that connects them all.
description.hr: Otoci od milijardi zvijezda razasuti kosmosom — ukljucujuci nas Mlijecni put i ogromnu mrezu koja ih sve povezuje.

back.en: A vast system of stars, gas, dust and dark matter bound by gravity. They range from millions to trillions of stars.
back.hr: Ogroman sistem zvijezda, plina, prasine i tamne materije povezan gravitacijom. Krecu se od miliona do biliona zvijezda.

front.en: What galaxy do we live in?

back.en: The Milky Way — a barred spiral holding 100–400 billion stars. On dark nights you can see its band arching overhead.
back.hr: Mlijecni put — spiralna galaksija s precagom, s 100–400 milijardi zvijezda. Za tamnih noci vidis njen pojas kako se luci nad glavom.

media.image_hint: NASA snimak trake Mlijecnog puta na nebu. Trazi 'Milky Way' na images.nasa.gov. Provjeri licencu.

back.en: A galaxy with graceful arms winding out from a bright center, full of gas and young stars. The Milky Way is one.
back.hr: Galaksija s gracioznim krakovima koji se odmotavaju iz sjajnog sredista, puna plina i mladih zvijezda. Mlijecni put je jedna od njih.

media.image_hint: NASA/Hubble snimak spiralne galaksije (npr. M81 ili Whirlpool/M51). Trazi 'spiral galaxy Hubble' na images.nasa.gov. Provjeri licencu.

front.en: What is the nearest large galaxy to ours?
front.hr: Koja je najbliza velika galaksija nasoj?

back.en: Andromeda, about 2.5 million light-years away — the most distant thing visible to the naked eye.
back.hr: Andromeda, oko 2,5 miliona svjetlosnih godina daleko — najudaljenija stvar vidljiva golim okom.

media.image_hint: NASA snimak Andromedine galaksije (M31). Trazi 'Andromeda Galaxy' na images.nasa.gov. Provjeri licencu.

front.hr: Hoce li nas Andromeda ikad dosegnuti?

back.en: Yes — it's heading our way and will merge with the Milky Way in about 4.5 billion years, forming a new giant galaxy.
back.hr: Da — krece se prema nama i spojit ce se s Mlijecnim putem za oko 4,5 milijardi godina, stvarajuci novu divovsku galaksiju.

back.en: Estimates run into the hundreds of billions, perhaps up to two trillion. Each one holds countless stars.
back.hr: Procjene idu u stotine milijardi, mozda i do dva biliona. Svaka sadrzi bezbroj zvijezda.

front.en: What hides at the center of most galaxies?
front.hr: Sta se krije u sredistu vecine galaksija?

back.en: A supermassive black hole. Ours, Sagittarius A*, has the mass of about 4 million Suns.
back.hr: Supermasivna crna rupa. Nasa, Strijelac A*, ima masu oko 4 miliona Sunaca.

back.en: A smooth, rounded galaxy of mostly old stars, with little gas to form new ones. Often the giants of the galaxy world.
back.hr: Glatka, zaobljena galaksija uglavnom starih zvijezda, s malo plina za stvaranje novih. Cesto divovi galaktickog svijeta.

front.en: How big is the Milky Way?

back.en: About 100,000 light-years across. Traveling at light speed, crossing it would take a thousand centuries.
back.hr: Oko 100.000 svjetlosnih godina u promjeru. Putujuci brzinom svjetlosti, prelazak bi trajao hiljadu stoljeca.

front.en: Where is the Sun within the Milky Way?
front.hr: Gdje je Sunce unutar Mlijecnog puta?

back.en: In a quiet spot about two-thirds out from the center, on a minor spiral arm. It takes ~225 million years to orbit once.
back.hr: Na mirnom mjestu oko dvije trecine puta od sredista, na manjem spiralnom kraku. Treba mu ~225 miliona godina za jedan krug.

back.en: The cluster of galaxies our Milky Way belongs to — dozens of galaxies bound together, dominated by us and Andromeda.
back.hr: Jato galaksija kojem pripada nas Mlijecni put — desetci galaksija povezanih zajedno, kojima dominiramo mi i Andromeda.

front.en: When we look at distant galaxies, what are we really seeing?
front.hr: Kad gledamo daleke galaksije, sta zapravo vidimo?

back.en: The past. Their light took millions or billions of years to reach us, so we see them as they were long ago — a time machine in the sky.
back.hr: Proslost. Njihovoj svjetlosti trebalo je milione ili milijarde godina da dodje do nas, pa ih vidimo kakve su bile davno — vremeplov na nebu.
